title: Right to Be Forgotten Policy Template - Data Deletion Request
metaDescription: Free template to create your Right to Be Forgotten policy. Exercise your right to erasure under GDPR and request personal data deletion.
description: A comprehensive policy template to help organizations implement Right to Be Forgotten procedures, ensuring compliance with GDPR Article 17 and providing clear processes for handling data deletion requests from individuals.

sections.heading: Purpose and Scope
sections.content: This Right to Be Forgotten Policy establishes procedures for handling requests from individuals to erase their personal data under Article 17 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This policy applies to all personal data processed by [COMPANY_NAME] and covers the rights of data subjects to have their personal information deleted when specific conditions are met.

sections.heading: Legal Basis for Data Erasure
sections.content: Under GDPR Article 17, individuals have the right to obtain erasure of personal data when: (a) the personal data is no longer necessary for the original purpose, (b) the data subject withdraws consent, (c) personal data has been unlawfully processed, (d) erasure is required for compliance with legal obligations, or (e) the data concerns a child under 16 years old. [COMPANY_NAME] will evaluate each request against these criteria and applicable legal requirements.

sections.heading: Request Submission Process
sections.content: Individuals may submit Right to Be Forgotten requests by: (1) Email to [PRIVACY_EMAIL], (2) Written request to [COMPANY_ADDRESS], or (3) Through our online form at [WEBSITE_URL]. Requests must include sufficient information to verify identity and specify the personal data to be erased. We recommend using a privacy-focused browser when submitting sensitive requests to protect your privacy during the process.

sections.heading: Identity Verification Requirements
sections.content: To prevent unauthorized data deletion, [COMPANY_NAME] requires identity verification for all erasure requests. Acceptable forms of identification include government-issued photo ID, recent utility bill, or other documents that confirm the requestor's identity. For online accounts, we may use existing account credentials as verification. All verification documents will be securely destroyed after processing.

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Process
sections.content: [COMPANY_NAME] will acknowledge receipt of Right to Be Forgotten requests within [ACKNOWLEDGMENT_DAYS] business days and provide a final response within one month of receipt. If the request is complex or numerous requests are received, we may extend this period by up to two months with notification to the requestor. Our response will confirm whether data has been erased or explain why the request cannot be fulfilled.

sections.heading: Exceptions and Limitations
sections.content: [COMPANY_NAME] may refuse erasure requests when processing is necessary for: exercising freedom of expression, compliance with legal obligations, public health purposes, archiving in the public interest, or establishment of legal claims. When refusing a request, we will explain the specific legal basis and inform the data subject of their right to lodge a complaint with supervisory authorities.

sections.heading: Third-Party Data Sharing
sections.content: When personal data has been shared with third parties, [COMPANY_NAME] will take reasonable steps to inform those parties about the erasure request, including any shared search results or public disclosures, unless this proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort. We maintain records of data sharing arrangements to facilitate this notification process.

sections.heading: Appeals and Contact Information
sections.content: If you are dissatisfied with our response to your Right to Be Forgotten request, you may: (1) Contact our Data Protection Officer at [DPO_EMAIL], (2) Submit an appeal to [APPEALS_EMAIL], or (3) Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. For questions about this policy, contact [PRIVACY_EMAIL] or write to [COMPANY_ADDRESS].
